attachments.insertion_landmark: iliotibial tract, continuing to Gerdy's tubercle

actions: flexes, abducts, internally rotates hip; tenses the IT band to stabilize the knee in extension

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Its tendon becomes the iliotibial band's proximal continuation, giving it a functional influence extending all the way to the knee -- a genuine two-joint muscle-tendon unit.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's whole-mount nerve staining, 20 cadaveric specimens (16 fixed, 4 fresh)
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Superior gluteal nerve branches entered the muscle only within parts 3-5 of a 20-part ASIS-to-patella scale (10.1-25%); main branches concentrated in parts 4-5 (15.1-25%), tiny branches sometimes extended to part 8 (up to ~38.8%, the muscle's own distal end). No branches were seen in parts 1-3 (0-15%).
motor_endplate_zones.source: Choi S, Yang HM, Cho TH, Yeo IS, Won SY (2023) Clin Anat 36(8):1089-1094, doi:10.1002/ca.24034 -- retrieved via PubMed

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Over the anterolateral proximal thigh where TFL forms a discrete fascial envelope between gluteus medius and sartorius/rectus femoris, visualized in short or long axis for direct sonographic needle guidance; the intramuscular target sits within 10-25% of the way from the ASIS to the patella (see motor_endplate_zones).
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Clinically validated: 45 patients received ultrasound-guided botulinum toxin A (Dysport) injection into TFL for lateral patellofemoral overload syndrome, with significant improvement in anterior knee pain scores sustained to a mean 5-year follow-up.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Stephen JM, Urquhart DWJ, van Arkel RJ, Ball S, Jaggard MKJ, Lee JC, Church JS (2016) Am J Sports Med 44(5):1195-1202, doi:10.1177/0363546516629432 -- retrieved via PubMed
